verdict.rationale: Paddle publishes a working llms.txt (confirmed via live probe at developer.paddle.com/llms.txt, HTTP 200) plus extensive agent-oriented docs: a dedicated AI SDK docs hub, a docs-MCP server, agent skills discoverable at a well-known JSON index, and an LLM integration benchmark explicitly instructing agents to load skills first. Probes independently corroborate the llms.txt and skills-index endpoints are live and machine-readable. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of an agent actually consuming llms.txt end-to-end (only first-party docs and probes).
